variable.description: User-service root (or gateway URL e.g. https://host/user-service)
state query param from B2C redirect; maps to the correct B2C policy (same PKCE, per-policy state)
Must match AZURE_AD_REDIRECT_URI used in authorize request

request.description: Callback route; SPA builds login.microsoftonline.com authorize with PKCE.
redirectUri optional; must match the redirect_uri used when obtaining code. Uses AZURE_AD_* env.
OAuth redirect target after B2C returns ?code=&state= to MS_REDIRECT_URI.
With Accept: application/json returns JSON code/state instead of redirect.
state from redirect = correct B2C user flow. flow/policy optional. Without state+mapping, use flow= or policy=.
Requires MS_POLICY_GMAIL_COMBINED. Same as policy=B2C_1_..._gmail for one-button sign-in+sign-up.
policy must be in allowlist (MS_POLICY_*, MS_B2C_POLICIES, defaults).
Logout current user and revoke all tokens
Revoke all refresh tokens for current user
